text:
lina_cs: Heads-up — Solara onboarding. They ramped their serverless pool and started seeing intermittent 429s on /v1/chat. Customer says it began right after increasing concurrent warmers from 6 -> 70.

lina_cs: sample from their logs: 
```
2026-03-22T11:04:01Z WARN id=s1 POST /v1/chat 429 x-rate-limit-remaining=0
2026-03-22T11:04:01Z INFO id=s2 POST /v1/chat 200
```

omar_se: ask whether they mint tokens per invocation and whether auth returns ttl. that pattern usually indicates per-invocation short-lived tokens + no connection reuse.

lina_cs: they confirmed: per-invocation mint, ttl=25s, python Lambda using requests without Session. provided snippet.

omar_se: recommend immediate fixes: 1) cache token in-process for ttl-5s, 2) use requests.Session() to reuse sockets, 3) add randomized splay on cold starts. share tiny code sample.

riley_support: I'll coordinate a 10% prod canary for them to roll the patch and request we open a 20-min mitigation window to soften hard 429s while they ramp.

ops_bot: mitigation created #CS-5510 owner=omar_se expires_in=20m playbook=token-cache-grace

lina_cs: customer reports staging metrics improved: 429s from 7.4% -> 0.4% within 10m after cache+session. starting canary now. will update. :thumbsup:
